prompt.project_info: Highly realistic vertical 2:3 mirror selfie of one original adult woman in a cozy bedroom, with DSLR-quality detail, natural skin texture and soft indoor light.
prompt.main_subject: One original adult woman with natural slightly tousled hair around the shoulders, defined makeup with subtle contour, soft blush, nude lipstick and lightly emphasized eyes. She kneels comfortably on a soft gray carpet with knees bent in a relaxed non-sexual pose, takes a mirror selfie and looks directly into the mirror with a confident relaxed gaze. She wears a loose cream oversized knit sweater with a flattering secure neckline and softly draped off-shoulder styling, plus pink satin ribbon bows on the right sleeve cuff and near the bottom hem. Do not reproduce Alia Bhatt or any other public-figure likeness.
prompt.composition_elements: Show the full body in an eye-level vertical mirror selfie, with emphasis on face and upper torso and slight background softness. The adult woman holds a gold smartphone in a pink bubble-pop fidget case. Place a white metal-frame bed with rumpled white sheets and pillows behind her, plain light-gray walls and soft gray carpet below.
prompt.lighting_and_atmosphere: Use even diffused soft indoor light with minimal shadows and a neutral-to-slightly-warm tone. Keep the room casual, cozy and confident with realistic fabric drape and natural skin detail.
prompt.technical_specs: Highly realistic 2:3 vertical mirror selfie, 50mm-equivalent perspective, sharp face and upper-torso focus, subtle background softness, realistic knit, satin ribbon, carpet, bed and phone texture, no text, logo or watermark.
